'''''Podachaenium''''' is a [[genus]] of [[Mesoamerican]] plants in the tribe [[Heliantheae]] within the family [[Asteraceae]].<ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/7723768#page/110/mode/1up Bentham, George in Oersted, Anders Sandoe. 1853.  Videnskabelige Meddelelser fra Dansk Naturhistorisk Forening i Kjøbenhavn 1852(5–7): 98–99] descriptions in Latin, information on Costa Rican type locale in Danish</ref><ref>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/40012403 Tropicos, ''Podachaenium'' Benth.]</ref>
